title: CrowdStrike Acquires Zscaler in $43.9 Billion Deal to Combine Endpoint and Network Security
content_md: CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $43.9 billion, bringing together two distinct security layers, software that monitors endpoints and cloud workloads, and a cloud service that inspects their connections. The companies announced the definitive agreement on November 23, 2026. It has not yet closed.
